prompt: Which of the following scenarios represents a valid use of **human-in-the-loop** in an agentic workflow?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Requiring human approval before an agent deploys to a production environment

options.text: Requiring human approval before an agent formats a comment
Requiring human approval before an agent deploys to a production environment
Requiring human approval before an agent reads a file
Requiring human approval before the agent queries a search tool
